title: A Mourning Sunset
medium: Pounded brass from artillery shells, enamel paint, patina, acrylic, plywood, metal bracket

said.q: The work is characteristic of Nguyen's sculptural practice, which transforms materials of destruction into monuments of memory and resistance. By repurposing instruments of imperialist warfare, the work is situated within a broader postcolonial inquiry, reanimating the past and, in the artist's own words, transforming something "meant for destruction and harm" into something that has the potential to heal.
